<b>Volt Filament</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It applies electrical damage to {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}}.

== Function ==
Volt Filament imbues {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}} with electric charge, giving them 25% more [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)|damage]], and adds a few ticks of 5 damage depending on the skill:
* [[Silkspear]] gets 2 ticks.
* [[Thread Storm]] gets 2 ticks. Extending Thread Storm adds 1 more tick.
* [[Cross Stitch]] gets 1 tick.
* [[Sharpdart]] gets 1 tick. Only the damage of the main hit is multiplied.
* [[Rune Rage]] gets 1 tick when 1-3 runes hit the same enemy, or 2 ticks for 4+ runes.
* [[Pale Nails]] gets 1 tick per each enemy hit, regardless of how many nails hit them.

This extra damage stacks with [[Shaman Crest]] additively. 

If a charged Skill contacts water, it will send a wave of electricity across the water's surface which hurts any enemies in the water. This wave deals several ticks of 8 damage in quick succession, and will typically hit a stationary enemy 6 times for a total of 48 damage. This bonus damage is unaffected by upgrades and other modifiers.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTlwqzpTeKE Volt Filament water interaction damage tests]</ref> This effect is useful for filling out the [[Muckmaggot]] entry in the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]], and may be effective in combat in more water-focused areas.

== How To Acquire == 
Found after defeating [[Voltvyrm]] in [[Voltnest]].
